title: A cross-wired snake 10
summary: Snake 10 of the installation is chained 28 up, 30 up, 29 down around a dead data output; the mapping file states the direction of each strip of a leg, the core places the LEDs by it, and the app gets a checkbox in Settings, Snake 10 is cross-wired, off by default and kept on the installation, which the snake test, the diagonal and the playback follow.
